cc:Work.dc:title: Tray - SmallPartsTray
cc:Work.dc:description:
Tray with slants to easier get out game tokens or screws
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes SmallPartsTray --sx '50*2' --y 90 --h 35 --thickness 3 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes SmallPartsTray --sx --y --h --reference
